title: Doro — design and implementation history

timeline.title: Blender-to-Unity transfer test
timeline.summary: BlenderBalls.fbx, a test unitypackage and an importer script exist in the early workspace. This was a pipeline probe, not the final café package. Date is the local artifact timestamp.

timeline.title: Reference image → reusable style system
timeline.summary: The shared chat starts with an uploaded style reference, asks for a neighboring coffee shop and then expands into asset guides, a 16:9 city composition and tilt-shift variants. Sunday timestamps align with the local reference-file dates.

timeline.title: Reference → editable 3D café crossroads
timeline.summary: Python scripts build architecture, street furniture, vehicles, static people, detailed foliage, a painted atlas, lighting and camera; source geometry remains editable and export copies are batched.

timeline.title: Existing scene → painted café environment
timeline.summary: Import under Assets/DoroPainted; normalize UV names before joining; rebuild URP materials; add camera controls, focus proxies and smooth depth-of-field updates without replacing existing gameplay objects.

timeline.title: Orbit, ambience and first public website
timeline.summary: Q/E orbit and park/bird/dog ambience are added and tested. A Unity WebGL build is hosted behind a branded HTML game shell; public-link access is selected.

timeline.title: Female sheet → Blender rig and actions
timeline.summary: The white-dress female character is built separately: 15 meshes, 38 bones, Idle/Walk/Wave and Blender/FBX deliverables.

timeline.title: Downloaded dance FBX → road performance
timeline.summary: Belly Dance.fbx is imported with a 19.63-second mixamo.com take, converted to URP materials and placed near the café sign and traffic signal. The intermediate external animation/retargeting steps are not recorded here.

timeline.title: Boy sheet → rigged reusable humanoid
timeline.summary: The approved sheet becomes a complete mesh/rig with five actions, separate FBXs, turnarounds and Unity Avatar validation. A linked idle instance is added to a separate Blender café copy.

timeline.title: Arrow-key player → updated public game
timeline.summary: A CharacterController, animation switching, camera-relative input, walking colliders and following camera are saved in the existing map. The browser game is rebuilt and published at the same public URL.
